title: Vibra project manifest source
description: The textual project.vib contract. The compiler applies the dedicated `(project ...)` S-expression grammar; this schema provides a coarse transport-level check only. The optional `(authority (grant <domain>.<action> [resource-prefix]) ...)` form declares runtime capability grants; omission is fail-closed for project execution. The optional `(limits fuel: <non-negative-int> memory: <non-negative-int>)` form declares independent execution ceilings; omitted labels are unbounded and limits do not grant authority.
